hash_pins: All existing source-lock, interpreter, fixture, candidate and baseline SHA-256 pins are unchanged. This packet does not contain every pinned dependency.
instruction: Replace every literal placeholder locally. Preserve Python string-literal syntax: use no quotes, backslashes or newlines unless correctly escaped. Keep resolved values private. The two helper invocations require independent fresh output locations and identifiers.

template_behavior: Only local paths and invocation identifiers were replaced. No functional correction or behavior change was applied.
